title: Maestro Asset Manifest
description: The generation spec for every visual asset the Game IR references by id. The IR carries only ids (background, sprite, icon, map); this manifest owns everything needed to PRODUCE the image: prompts, dimensions, animations, style anchors. One id space shared with the IR — every asset id the IR references must exist here. NOTE: the on-disk manifest is NOT authored freehand — it is DERIVED, complete by construction, by maestro.asset_stubs.reconcile_stubs, which the authoring tools call after every visual write. Its real shape is typed stub lists (backgrounds/characters/tokens/items/cgs/features/tiles/markers + title_card), each entry an {id, image_file, description, prompt} stub; the styled prompt stage (maestro.asset_prompts) saves the final `prompt` per entry and a shared `style.prompt` brief. This `assets`-array schema is the older aspirational contract; asset_stubs.py is the source of truth for the shipped shape. Design rationale lives in game_ir_decisions.md.

style.description: Optional global style applied to every asset's prompt (art direction the whole game shares).

prompt.description: Style suffix mixed into every generation, e.g. 'painterly noir, muted palette'.

music.description: Ambient/score tracks tied to WHERE a track plays (place ids for a world/room game, background ids for a VN scene). v1 DERIVES this set deterministically from place kinds + scene locations + story tone (maestro.music.derive_music) — no LLM authoring yet; the shape is declared here so a future version can author or override tracks the way it authors sprites. Each entry generates one audio file the engine plays per place/scene.

id.description: Track id; its audio file is <id>.wav under game/audio/music/.

prompt.description: Generation prompt (mood/instrumentation) for the music model.

locations.description: Background ids (VN scene locations) this track scores.

id.description: Matches the id the IR references (background/sprite/icon/map).

kind.description: What slot this fills + its generation defaults.

prompt.description: Positive generation prompt for the image.

width.description: Override default size for the kind.

transparent.description: Request an alpha background (sprites, portraits, item icons).

style_ref.description: Optional asset id to anchor style/character consistency against.

animations.description: Optional animation states. Omit for a still image.

name.description: State name, e.g. idle / walk / talk / attack.

fps.description: Playback rate; defaults to a per-kind value.

loop.description: Whether the state loops (idle/walk) or plays once (attack).
